caption:
Your team closes a job and moves straight to the next one.

Nobody remembers to ask for the review. By the time someone does, the customer has already forgotten how good the work was.

Example workflow below. Illustrative only, not a live client account:

1. Job status flips to Complete in the CRM
2. An SMS fires automatically asking for a 1-5 star rating
3. 4-5 stars routes straight to your Google review link while it's fresh
4. 1-3 stars alerts you privately, before it ever goes public
5. No response in 3 days triggers one follow-up message, then nothing

Most shops with a formal ask outrun the ones leaving it to memory.

Want this running behind every closed job?
